ios.desc:
Using Slideshow Maker with Music you can easily create amazing SLIDESHOW videos from your Photos and SHARE to everyone on FACEBOOK, TWITTER, INSTAGRAM, VINE, SNAPCHAT, WHATSAPP, TELEGRAM and many other apps.


Features & Instructions
=================


• SLIDESHOW THEME: Turn your photos into amazing slideshow using amazing themes.

• REORDER PHOTOS: Reorder your photos, delete or add more photos.

• TRACKS: Add songs from iTunes, Genres or voice to your slideshow.

• MUSIC TRACKS: Choose from Happy, Inspiring, Cinematic, Relaxing, Party, Dance etc.

• VOICE OVER: Record your voice and merge them to make charismatic slideshow.

• FILTERS: Choose from a large number of vibrant filters.

• FRAMES: Decorate your slideshow with amazing frames for all festivals..

• SHARE SLIDESHOW: Share your amazing moment on Instagram, Facebook, Vine, Twitter, Snapchat or by E-mail.
